specs.label: Stream Type
specs.value: Encoder: Pixel Perfect Processing (default) or DM-NVX-D10/D20/D200 Series; Decoder: Pixel Perfect Processing or DM-NVX-E10/E20 Series

specs.label: Video Resolutions

specs.value: Multichannel (up to 8-channel LPCM or encoded HBR 7.1 surround sound), 2-channel LPCM

specs.label: Bit Rates
specs.value: Encoder: Fixed (200 to 950 Mbps - user specified),; Adaptive (dependent on input resolution of the stream), or; Variable (less than 150 Mbps to maximum of 750 Mbps, dependent on content and input resolution of the stream

specs.label: Output Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, Deep Color, and 4K60 4:4:4 support (DVI compatible)

specs.label: Switcher
specs.value: 2x1 in decoder mode (HDMI, Stream), manual or auto-switching, limited audio breakaway, Crestron QuickSwitch HD™ technology
